scheme_name: Financial Assistance On Marriage Of Children (HBOCWWB)
description:
The Financial Assistance on Marriage of Children scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Government of India.

This scheme is specifically designed to provide financial support to the children of registered construction workers.

The scheme was launched by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB) in 2008.

The primary objective of this scheme is to assist registered construction workers in managing the financial burden associated with the marriage of their children.

The scheme aims to promote the welfare of construction workers by alleviating the financial stress during such significant life events.

Under this scheme, a financial assistance amount of ₹51,000 is provided for the marriage of each daughter.

For the marriage of sons, the assistance amount is ₹31,000.

The financial assistance is intended to cover various expenses related to the marriage ceremony.

Eligible beneficiaries must be registered construction workers under the HBOCWWB.

To qualify for the financial assistance, the applicant must have a valid registration with the HBOCWWB.

The applicant must also provide proof of the marriage of their child.

The age limit for daughters is set at a minimum of 18 years at the time of marriage.

For sons, there is no specific age limit mentioned.

The income criteria for eligibility require that the family income of the applicant should not exceed ₹3 lakh per annum.

This income limit is aimed at ensuring that the assistance reaches the economically weaker sections of society.

The application process for this scheme involves several steps.

First, the applicant must obtain the application form from the local office of the HBOCWWB.

The application form can also be downloaded from the official website of the HBOCWWB.

Once the form is obtained, the applicant must fill it out with accurate details.

The applicant must attach necessary documents such as proof of registration with the HBOCWWB.

Documents required include a copy of the marriage invitation card or certificate.

The applicant must also provide proof of income, such as an income certificate or pay slip.

After completing the application form and gathering the necessary documents, the applicant must submit the application to the local office of the HBOCWWB.

The application must be submitted within a specific timeframe after the marriage ceremony.

The processing of applications typically takes about 30 days from the date of submission.

Disbursement of funds is made directly to the bank account of the beneficiary.

The financial assistance is provided in a one-time payment.

The scheme is implemented by the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The HBOCWWB operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Government of Haryana.

For more information, beneficiaries can contact the HBOCWWB office directly.

The contact details for the HBOCWWB can be found on their official website.

The scheme has been instrumental in supporting the families of construction workers.

It has helped reduce the financial burden associated with marriages.

The assistance provided under this scheme is a significant amount for many families.

The scheme has been well-received by the construction worker community.

As of 2023, thousands of families have benefited from this initiative.

The scheme is part of a broader effort by the Government of Haryana to enhance the welfare of construction workers.

The HBOCWWB also offers various other welfare schemes for construction workers.

These include health insurance, educational assistance, and pension schemes.

The Financial Assistance on Marriage of Children scheme is one of the most popular initiatives.

It addresses a critical need within the community.

The scheme not only provides financial support but also promotes social stability.

By assisting families during marriage ceremonies, the government aims to foster a sense of community.

The scheme reflects the government's commitment to the welfare of the working class.

It is an important step towards ensuring that no family is burdened by the costs of marriage.

The financial assistance helps families celebrate marriages with dignity.

The scheme is a testament to the government's recognition of the challenges faced by construction workers.

It highlights the importance of providing targeted support to vulnerable populations.

The scheme has undergone various reviews to enhance its effectiveness.

Feedback from beneficiaries has been taken into account for improvements.

The government continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme.

Regular assessments are conducted to ensure that the objectives are being met.

The scheme is funded by the contributions made by construction workers.

These contributions are collected under the Building and Other Construction Workers (Regulation of Employment and Conditions of Service) Act, 1996.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is non-refundable.

This means that beneficiaries do not have to repay the amount received.

The scheme is a crucial part of the social safety net for construction workers in Haryana.

It plays a vital role in promoting gender equality by supporting the marriage of daughters.

The assistance amount is significant in the context of rising wedding expenses.

Overall, the Financial Assistance on Marriage of Children scheme is a well-structured initiative.

It aims to provide timely and effective support to construction workers during critical life events.
